description: Chemicals and Substances: substance identity (PubChem PUG-REST, US EPA CompTox), harmonised and notified CLP classifications with every ATP revision, REACH registration status, SVHC Candidate List events and Annex XIV/XVII entries (ECHA CHEM), and published toxicity data points (CompTox ToxValDB), bounded to an explicit substance set. Every value is quoted as published with its source, revision and dates. No hazard or exposure assessment, safety advice or synthesis information is acquired. Access audit: docs/roadmaps/chemicals-substances-source-audit.md.

defaults.update_cadence: weekly re-check of the explicit selection; ECHA lists change by dated amendment, PubChem and CompTox records carry their own version or release
defaults.temporal_semantics: provider-declared dates (ATP application date, list inclusion/amendment/removal date, registration last-updated date, PubChem modification date, ToxValDB release); every distinct payload is an immutable revision; absence from a response never implies removal

sources.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine, NCBI (PubChem)
sources.scope: PubChem compound identity for the explicitly selected CIDs: CID, InChI, InChIKey, preferred and IUPAC names, depositor synonyms (CAS and EC numbers among them, conflicts kept) and the modification date as record version

license.redistribution: public data with attribution 'Source: PubChem, National Library of Medicine'; depositor records may carry their own terms (verify per depositor)
